title: A trophic flow model of the Golfo de Nicoya, Costa Rica
authors: Matthias Wolff; Volker Koch; Juan Bautista Chavarría; José A. Vargas
loadability_evidence: Ecobase model 677 records 21 groups and one fleet; native model import not attempted. Published PDF accessible; complete table extraction and balance validation remain required.
documentation_evidence: ECOPATH II estuary model; paper describes biomass, catches, food spectrum and dynamics, plus input/output tables.
notes: 1,530 km2 estuary includes inner shallow gulf and outer gulf to shelf edge; not Costa Rica's entire Pacific EEZ.
quality_rationale: Provisional screening score. A readable source is not evidence of a successfully reconstructed or load-tested Ecopath model. recommendation: Gulf of Nicoya estuary, 1,530 km2, northwest Pacific coast of Costa Rica.
